Orb uses one app package for Stable and Beta. Only the selected GitHub release channel is checked, and Android always asks you to confirm installation.
Android notifications are off. Orb will still show available updates inside the app when you open it.

You will receive test versions of Orb before the stable release. They may include new features, unfinished changes or instability. When a new Beta is available, Orb will notify you and show the full changelog. Nothing is downloaded until you choose Download.

Orb will stop checking pre-releases and switch to the stable channel. When a newer compatible stable version is available, Orb will notify you and show the full changelog. Nothing is downloaded until you choose Download. Your app data will be kept.
Stable channel enabled. Orb will notify you when the next compatible stable release is available.
